findings.title: Conflicting target is outside the headline result
findings.expected: Reader recognizes the target needs confirmation.
findings.observed: The trace explicitly skips the source discrepancy and the typed note reports 18.29% without qualification.
findings.cost: Uncertainty can be lost in feedback shared with others. This is an inference from the omitted caveat, not proof of real-user prevalence.
findings.fix: Put Target needs confirmation in overview and result badges; mark the detailed target under review.
findings.fix_signal: Both the overview and selected-result headline expose uncertainty before body helper text.
findings.regression_risk: Do not change source numbers or classify all measures as uncertain.

findings.title: Review controls require long vertical travel
findings.expected: Prepare a link and note close to the selected result.
findings.observed: Scrolled up two screens to copy, then down four and another two-and-a-half screens to reach the note field.
findings.cost: Extra scrolling and loss of result context; the task was recovered.
findings.fix: Add measure-local copy and review-note actions, plus the header shortcut.
findings.fix_signal: From the measure, copy the current URL and follow a direct link to a focused feedback section.
findings.regression_risk: Copied link must still name the selected measure and chart view.

findings.title: Primary feedback action saves locally rather than preparing a shareable file
findings.observed: Tester would press the blue local-save button. It stopped before saving and knew the note was not yet shared.
findings.cost: Potential extra step or confusion; no false belief of delivery was observed.
findings.fix: Make Download review notes primary and preserve explicit local-save wording.
findings.fix_signal: Download is first and primary; text clearly says no automatic submission.
findings.regression_risk: Retain local save and storage recovery.
findings.ablation: Remove Visual-Path Follower to test whether action prominence changes the route.

errata.correction: Use the tester’s following correction and screenshot. The original description invents a summary not present in the screenshot; no product finding is based on it.
